title: Mechanistic Probe: Initial Feature Variance in Normalization Synergy (v3 - Bugfix)
abstract: This is a resubmission of the failed probe (ID 843). The previous attempt failed due to a simple `NameError` because `jit` was not imported. This version corrects the import statement. The probe analyzes the initial feature variance of four architectural configurations (no LN, internal LN, external LN, and both) to understand the mechanism behind their synergistic performance.
